Description
Bullion Trading LLC is excited to announce the latest addition to our precious metal selection, the 25x 1 gram Gold Maple Leafs Maplegram coins. These coins are produced by the esteemed Royal Canadian Mint, which has been delivering precious metals of the finest quality since its inception.
The Canadian Gold Maple Leaf coins are amongst the most popular and in-demand coins because of their unique design and high liquidity. 25x 1 gram Gold Maple Leafs Maplegram comprises 25 coins, each weighing 1 gram with .9999 fine gold. Each coin in the set of 25 has its unique serial number and individual sheets of blister packaging with an assay card for authenticity.
Design of 25x 1 gram Gold Maple Leafs Maplegram
The 25x 1 gram Gold Maple Leafs Maplegram holds a special designation in the gold bullion world, for they are a work of art. Be it for gifting or for collecting; the coins can be easily separated into 1-gram coins from their blister pack.
The obverse of the coin feature the effigy of Queen Elizabeth II without the crown, designed by Susanna Blunt. The coin’s reverse features the famous sugar maple leaf, a staple for the reverse of all Canadian Mapel Leaf coins. The inscription also includes the purity and weight of the metal.
Main Highlights of 25x 1 gram Gold Maple Leafs Maplegram
Collection of 25 coins, each weighing 1 gram
Produced by the Royal Canadian Mint
The 25 x 1 gram coins contain .999 fine gold
Face value of 50 cents(CAD)
Each coin is packaged in a divisible blister card with a unique serial number for each 1-gram coin on the back of the assay card
Observe features the portrait of Queen Elizabeth II, and the inscription of the date.
Reverse features the design of the famous maple leaf, the weight, and purity  of the coin
